question: P borrows a sum of ₹5,00,000 from a bank which charges simple interest at 18% per annum at the beginning of the year. He pays 11 equal monthly installments of ₹40,000 and mortgages his bike at the end of the year to pay the remaining amount. What is the value of a pledged bike?
solution:
Given:

Principal (P) = ₹5,00,000

Rate of interest (R) = 18% per annum

Time (T) = 1 year

Monthly Installment = ₹40,000

Number of Installments = 11

Formula used:

Interest (I) = (Principal × Rate × Time) / 100

Calculation:

⇒ I = (5,00,000 × 18 × 1) / 100

⇒ I = ₹90,000

Total amount to be paid by P by the end of the year:

⇒ Total Payment = Principal + Interest

⇒ Total Payment = 5,00,000 + 90,000

⇒ Total Payment = ₹5,90,000

Amount paid through monthly installments:

⇒ Amount paid through installments = 40,000 × 11

⇒ Amount paid through installments = ₹4,40,000

The remaining amount to be paid:

⇒ Remaining Amount = Total Payment - Amount paid through installments

⇒ Remaining Amount = 5,90,000 - 4,40,000

⇒ Remaining Amount = ₹1,50,000

Therefore, the value of the pledged bike to pay the remaining amount is ₹1,50,000.
